caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile design with a repeated geometric and floral pattern. The main composition consists of a grid of fifteen squares (arranged in three rows of five), each containing a central red circular motif with a four-sided, faceted, gem-like shape outlined in white at its center. Surrounding each red circle is a green spiked border and green vine-like stems. Each square is adorned with red flowers with yellow centers and green leaves positioned around the central red motif. The entire grid is bordered by a wide frame featuring a repeating pattern of green wavy foliage and large red floral shapes spaced evenly along the outer edge. The dominant colors are red, green, and white, with touches of yellow in the flower centers, and the background is an off-white or light beige. The design appears symmetrical and evenly spaced, with clear separation between each motif and a distinct border enclosing the composition.
title: Applique Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
